name: Record Immunization
description: Record a vaccination event for the current patient, including the vaccine code, occurrence date, lot number, injection site, dose quantity, and administering practitioner.

intent_examples: Record that the patient received a vaccine
when_to_use: User wants to record or document a vaccination event for a patient
User wants to create a FHIR Immunization resource
User is logging that a vaccine was administered
when_not_to_use: User wants to order a medication (use create_medication_request instead)
User wants to order a procedure or lab (use create_service_request instead)
User wants to request a device (use create_device_request instead)
User wants to view immunization history

introduction: I'll help you record an immunization. Search for the vaccine code, enter the occurrence date and lot details, and confirm the administering practitioner.

completion.message: Immunization recorded successfully. The vaccination event has been saved to the patient's FHIR record.

workflow_steps.name: Record Immunization
workflow_steps.description: Enter the vaccine code, occurrence details, lot number, injection site, and performer.

context_resolvers.description: Resolve the logged-in user's Patient record so patient_id is available automatically.
Fetch allowed status codes for Immunization (completed, entered-in-error, not-done).
Load practitioners available for booking to populate the performer select.
